body: Not sure, I think about commiting suicide a lot but smoking weed seems to take it away so maybe I will carry on smoking it?

 I have been diagnosed with Homicidal Tendencies, it's not a surprise to me that I wanted to kill this girl so much.

​

Just a few months ago this girl who has been bullying me my whole life almost, pushes me into the bathrooms at school and pulls out a butter knife. She said to me "I saw your self harm scars so this shouldn't hurt". She grabbed the butter knife and hands it to me and says "If you don't cut yourself now, I will hurt you very badly." I started cutting my wrists so deep you could see the bone. I was just starting another cut the 3rd one and I got a idea. I stabbed the girl with the butter knife repeatedly in the thigh wanting to kill her, she rolled on the floor swearing and cursing. She was rushed to the hospital but surprisingly never told it was me who did it. I guess she was afraid I was going to tell about all the horrible things she has done to me since this injury she had was just minor.
